description: This file contains the PHP class 'Event' in the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Marketplace'. It defines a controller for managing marketplace events, including listing, enabling, disabling, and deleting events within the OpenCart admin interface.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Controller class managing marketplace events in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the event listing page with breadcrumbs, filters, and event data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list view of marketplace events with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the list of marketplace events with sorting, pagination, and filters.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables a specific marketplace event by its ID, returning JSON response.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables a specific marketplace event by its ID, returning JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected marketplace events, returning JSON response.
